items.title: Borderland Diplomacy: Western Elites and the "Spanish Conspiracy"
items.venue: Register of the Kentucky Historical Society
items.note: Reads the Kentucky dealings with Spanish Louisiana, in which Wilkinson was the central go-between, as western elite diplomacy rather than simple treason.

items.title: The Burr Conspiracy: Uncovering the Story of an Early American Crisis
items.note: Includes a chapter on the 1806 cipher letter as a narrative that Wilkinson decoded, altered and circulated, the best-studied of his coded documents.

items.title: Spanish Attempts to Apprehend Lewis and Clark
items.who: D. Sturdevant and J. H. Buckley
items.note: Traces how Wilkinson's secret reports to Spanish officials prompted expeditions to intercept Lewis and Clark, showing what his dispatches could set in motion.

items.title: wilkinson: deciphering the Wilkinson cipher
items.note: Public transcriptions of Library of Congress photostat letters, extracted wordbanks, an evaluation pair and unsolved letters split by the 1078 and 1096 code systems.

items.title: Solving Historical Dictionary Codes with a Neural Language Model
items.who: C. Chu, R. Valenti and K. Knight
items.note: Lattice search with a neural language model recovered about 75% of word tokens in a held-out letter without identifying the printed dictionary behind the code.
